parsed.name: 通用 GPIO PWM 输出器件
parsed.description: 一种通过 GPIO 引脚输出脉宽调制信号的通用物理输出器件/通道，可在实验中调节占空比与频率，用于驱动 LED 亮度、蜂鸣器强度、执行器功率或其他支持 PWM 的负载。
parsed.description_en: A generic physical GPIO output device/channel that emits pulse-width modulation signals. It is used in experiments to adjust duty cycle and frequency for driving LED brightness, buzzer intensity, actuator power, or other PWM-capable loads.

actions.description: 使 PWM 输出按设定时间循环开关或渐变闪烁。
actions.description_en: Make the PWM output repeatedly switch on/off or fade according to timing parameters.

actions.description: 关闭器件并释放 GPIO 资源。
actions.description_en: Close the device and release the GPIO resource.

actions.description: 获取/设置 PWM 脉冲频率。
actions.description_en: Get/set the PWM pulse frequency.

actions.description: 关闭 PWM 输出。
actions.description_en: Turn the PWM output off.

actions.description: 将 PWM 输出设为全开。
actions.description_en: Turn the PWM output fully on.

actions.description: 使 PWM 输出反复淡入淡出。
actions.description_en: Make the PWM output repeatedly fade in and out.

actions.description: 在关闭与全开状态之间切换输出。
actions.description_en: Toggle the output between off and fully on.

actions.description: 获取/设置 PWM 占空比。
actions.description_en: Get/set the PWM duty cycle.

actions.description: 获取输出是否处于激活状态。

actions.description_en: Get/set whether the active state corresponds to a high logic level.
